title: Software Developer

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: MASCO 2512 is supported by the official MASCO 2020 classification.
evidence_notes.skills: Six selected skills are based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer profile, printed pages 106-107.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: Low AI impact is based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer classification, not an independently calculated prediction.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: Skill importance weights (1-4) are team-defined assumptions and are not official TalentCorp scores.
evidence_notes.job_market: DOSM Q2 2026 reports 19,899 online job offerings for Software Developers. This is a single observation, not proof of increasing demand.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4). Not official TalentCorp or ESCO scores.
occupation_mapping_note: Malaysian Software Developers (MASCO 2512) mapped to TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer and ESCO software developer (ISCO 2512). These occupation records are not identical.
ai_impact_note: Low AI impact according to the TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer classification. This does not imply zero automation risk or guaranteed job security.

title: Accountants and Auditors

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: Accountants and Auditors are classified under MASCO 2411.
evidence_notes.skills: Six selected skills are drawn from TalentCorp's Global Business Services Finance and Accounting Function skills table, printed page 95. The table describes a job cluster, not every individual accounting role.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: TalentCorp identifies Cost Accountant, Internal Auditor and General Ledger Accountant among medium AI-impacted GBS roles. No single AI-impact level is assigned to the entire MASCO 2411 occupation.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: Skill importance weights from 1 to 4 are team-defined estimates, not official TalentCorp scores.
evidence_notes.job_market: DOSM reported 22,067 online job offerings for Accountants and Auditors in Q2 2026. This is a quarterly observation, not a forecast or a skill-demand measurement.
evidence_notes.sdgs: SDG 4, 8 and 16 mappings are project-defined interpretations, not official TalentCorp classifications.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4). Not official TalentCorp scores.
occupation_mapping_note: MASCO 2411 Accountants and Auditors is broader than the Finance and Accounting Function roles covered by the TalentCorp GBS study.
ai_impact_note: AI impact varies by accounting role. Medium impact is documented for specified GBS specialisations, but should not be generalized to every Accountant and Auditor.

title: Data Professionals

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: MASCO 2524 is the Malaysian Data Professionals occupation group. It covers multiple data-related specializations, not just Data Analysts.
evidence_notes.skills: Six selected skills are informed by MASCO 2524 duties and the eMASCO Data Analyst (2524-02) specialization. Python, SQL and Critical Thinking are supported by the specialization, not necessarily every job in the broader occupation group.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: Weights 1-4 are team-defined estimates. MASCO and eMASCO do not supply these numeric importance weights.
evidence_notes.job_market: MyCOL 2024/2025 includes specified Data Professionals job titles. No occupation-specific DOSM time-series or growth rate has been established for this career.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: No occupation-wide AI-impact grade or job-replacement probability is asserted for Data Professionals.
evidence_notes.sdgs: SDG 4, 8 and 9 are team-defined relevance interpretations, not measured social outcomes.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative 1-4 skill weights. General duties are supported by MASCO 2524; additional skills are supported by the eMASCO Data Analyst (2524-02) specialization. No official numerical skill ratings are claimed.
occupation_mapping_note: MASCO 2524 covers Data Scientists, Data Analysts and other data professionals; no precise O*NET-SOC equivalence has been verified.
ai_impact_note: No validated Malaysian occupation-wide AI impact score. OECD/ILO occupational exposure will be linked separately after reviewing the MASCO-to-O*NET mapping.

title: Advertising and Marketing Professionals

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: eMASCO identifies Advertising and Marketing Professionals under MASCO 2431; this is a broad occupational group.
evidence_notes.skills: The specific six-skill selection uses eMASCO group-level tasks and Marketing Executive (2431-02) skills as a representative subset. Not every speciality has identical requirements.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: The six importance weights 1–4 are team estimates for a hackathon readiness model, not official MASCO or employer-rated scores.
evidence_notes.job_market: MyCOL 2024/2025 includes selected marketing-related job titles, which does not establish a current vacancy trend or growth percentage.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: No verified, group-wide Malaysian AI-impact classification is assigned. OECD/ILO exposure integration pending.
evidence_notes.sdgs: SDG 4 and SDG 8 are team-defined interpretations, not official outcome measurements.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4). Not official eMASCO or TalentCorp ratings.
occupation_mapping_note: Marketing Executive (2431-02) is a representative sub-occupation used to support several skills for the wider MASCO 2431 unit group.
ai_impact_note: No verified Malaysian occupation-wide AI-impact rating has been established. Do not interpret the skill weights as AI risk.

title: Electrical Engineers

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: eMASCO 2151 describes the broad Malaysian Electrical Engineers occupation.
evidence_notes.skills: Skills are selected and paraphrased from the eMASCO general duties; simulation is a team-selected learning extension and not explicitly listed as a separate compulsory eMASCO skill.
evidence_notes.industry_ai_context: TalentCorp E&E report printed pp. 28–29 (PDF p.15) discusses industry trends, not occupation-wide risk for all electrical engineers.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: All 1–4 weights are team estimates, not official survey measurements.
evidence_notes.sdgs: SDG tags are team interpretations, not measured societal outcomes.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4), not official eMASCO or TalentCorp ratings.
occupation_mapping_note: E&E specialist roles in TalentCorp report do not map directly onto all MASCO 2151 engineers.
ai_impact_note: No verified occupation-wide Malaysian AI impact grade; the E&E report offers sector context only.

title: Nursing Professionals

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: MASCO 2221 and its nursing roles: eMASCO official category page, description and Tugasan.
evidence_notes.skills: Five nursing skills from eMASCO Professional Nurse 2221-01 description, tasks and Asas/Khusus skills; Critical Thinking reused from existing skills.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: 1–4 values are team estimates for demo matching, not official ratings.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: No nursing occupation-wide AI-exposure or job replacement risk determined from the Medical Devices report.
evidence_notes.learning: Courses are free foundations/partial coverage; online learning is not supervised clinical practice or Malaysian registration.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative importance weights 1–4; eMASCO supports relevance but not numeric ratings.
occupation_mapping_note: MASCO group 2221 is broader than the Professional Nurse 2221-01 skills profile used as a representative specialization.
ai_impact_note: Unassessed for the overall MASCO 2221 group. TalentCorp Medical Devices report does not assess Nursing Professionals as a whole.
